up: Return rows from the activities table for target CHEMBL2959 (Tyrosine-protein kinase ITK/TSK) where the standard_type is 'IC50' and pchembl_value is not null. Include only rows with an exact standard relation ('='). Return the first 1000 rows ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. For each row, provide: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, target tax_id, molecule canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value.
sql: WITH base_data AS (SELECT a.assay_id, a.molregno, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value, td.target_type, td.tax_id FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2959' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.molregno LIMIT 1000) SELECT bd.assay_id AS assay_chembl_id, bd.target_type, bd.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, bd.standard_type, bd.pchembl_value FROM base_data bd JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON bd.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON bd.molregno = cs.molregno ORDER BY md.chembl_id, bd.assay_id
